name: claude-auto-repo-setup
description: On session start and working-directory change, ensures local-only Claude conveniences in the current git repo: creates CLAUDE.md pointing at an existing AGENTS.md, and symlinks each skill under .github/skills and each agent under .github/agents individually into .claude/, skipping any repo skill whose name collides with a built-in Claude Code skill (e.g. code-review) to avoid crashing skill loading. Idempotent, side-effect-safe, and adds everything to the repo's local git excludes so nothing is committed.
